{{Quote|The Hailfires were in missile range and I had warning indicators everywhere when it happened. One moment I'm running along and the next I'm on my back and looking back the way I came&mdash;upside down.|An excerpt from ''Geonosian Debriefings, Vol. III'' (Subject CT-1226)|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
'''CT-1226''' was the designation of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] serving in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. CT-1226 participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the war on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], when the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] assaulted Separatist forces there.

During the battle, CT-1226 shot a Confederate [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|B2-HA series super battle droid]] with their [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] as it prepared to launch a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] at Republic [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. This caused the missile to instead hit a Confederate [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tank]], destroying it and allowing the Republic walkers to march through the hole created in the Separatist defensive screen. CT-1226 later received a commendation for that act.

==Biography==
===Fighting at Geonosis===
{{Quote|Then the HUD lit up everywhere. I cranked up my magnification and saw just about every kind of clanker on the Sep roster coming at us&mdash;a wall of Hailfires and spiders and supers and a bunch of red-armored B1s thrown in for kicks, all coming hot.|An excerpt from ''Geonosian Debriefings, Vol. III'' (Subject CT-1226)|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
[[File:Drop_Zone_EaW.png|thumb|right|300px|CT-1226 fought for the Galactic Republic on Geonosis.]]
CT-1226<ref name="Warfare" /> was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="SWE" /> During their grooming to become a clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], CT-1226 participated in live-fire exercises and other training. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] exploded across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The war's [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] was on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where CT-1226 and other clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] [[Ground warfare/Legends|fought]] against the forces of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="Warfare" />

CT-1226 and their [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] were deployed near where the initial Republic strike had destroyed Confederate [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transports]]. Followed by Republic [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and four [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery]] units, CT-1226 and the other troopers pushed across a plateau in a skirmish line in the direction of the Separatist headquarters. During deployment, the [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] of the [[Armor/Legends|helmet's]] [[Heads-up display/Legends|HUD]] used by CT-1226 went static every [[Time/Legends|time]] something loud occurred, preventing them from hearing what their [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] or the rest of their [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were saying. Despite this inconvenience, they wer able to stay with the group, as he could still see them.<ref name="Warfare" />

CT-1226 and the skirmish line soon came in contact with a wall of Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], including [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]], [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. After the Republic forces came into range of the [[Missile/Legends|missile]]-equipped Hailfire [[Droid/Legends|droids]], CT-1226 was nearly hit by a [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|blast]] from an AT-TE with a malfunctioning guidance system. The blast left them in a crater on their back, with their[[Limb/Legends|feet]] oriented toward the top of the hole and their HUD out. Once CT-1226 reoriented themselves, they began to climb out of the crater, only to duck back in as a Hailfire droid rolled over the top of the crater, with a wheel on each side of the hole.<ref name="Warfare" />

===Fighting battle droids===
{{Quote|I knocked the super down hard just as it launched a missile at our lines, and it wound up with its launcher sticking into the dirt like a spear. Instead of going over the Hailfire's head, the missile hits it dead center and turns it into a huge fireball.|Excerpt from ''Geonosian Debriefings, Vol. III'' (Subject CT-1226)|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
CT-1226 aimed their [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at the droid as it stopped to recalibrate its targeting a short distance off, but lowered it as he reasoned the blaster would not do any damage to it. Turning, they came face to face with two B1 battle droids at the top of the crater, aiming their [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]] at them. Behind them came a [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|B2-HA series super battle droid]], armed with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] arm. However, unlike the B1 droids, the B2-HA did not see CT-1226 in the crater, and instead smashed the two droids aside as they stood between it and the AT-TEs.<ref name="Warfare" />

[[File:SBD.png|thumb|left|300px|CT-1226 destroyed a B2-HA battle droid armed with a missile launcher.]]
As the B2-HA battle droid continued around the side of the crater, CT-1226 shot the droid as it launched a missile at the Republic lines, knocking the B2-HA down and leaving its missile launcher stuck in the dirt. The missile ended up hitting the same Hailfire that had passed over the crater, instead of going over its head, causing the droid to explode into bits. The resulting explosion forced CT-1226 to duck as pieces of the droid rained down. He threw an [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenade]] at the B2-HA, and then ran over to it and shot it in the back a couple of times to destroy the droid.<ref name="Warfare" />

The destruction of the Hailfire droid punched a hole in the droid [[Army/Legends|army's]] defensive screen, allowing the AT-TEs to march through. A couple of [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] later, CT-1226 got into one of the walkers' crew cabins and was given a new HUD. CT-1226 received a commendation by the battle's [[General/Legends|generals]] for their quick thinking and resourcefulness, even though he tried to refuse. A debriefing from CT-1226 on the battle was included in ''[[Geonosian Debriefings, Vol. III]]''.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I got a commendation for that. I tried to refuse it, but the generals kept talking about quick thinking and resourcefulness. Quick thinking? The smartest thing I did was fall in the hole.|Excerpt from ''Geonosian Debriefings, Vol. III'' (Subject CT-1226)|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
During the First Battle of Geonosis, CT-1226 was able to cope with the static on their HUD due to the training he received on Kamino. When he saw [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] of droids coming at the clone forces shortly after deployment, CT-1226 reasoned that they were on the right path to the Separatist headquarters because of the number of troops guarding it, but also realized the clone force would get decimated without air support. When CT-1226 had a shot at the Hailfire, he neglected to take it, as he reasoned it would do no damage to the large droid even at close range. Due to their recent time in the crater, he was able to understand the confusion that the B2-HA series super battle droid experienced after finding its missile arm in the ground, though he knew he would be [[Death/Legends|dead]] if he let the droid get up, so he eliminated it. He also tried to refuse the commendation for their quick thinking and resourcefulness after he blew a hole in the Separatist lines, as he thought the only smart thing he did was fall in the crater.<ref name="Warfare" /> As a clone of Jango Fett, CT-1226 stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
In combat, he used a blaster from the [[DC-15]] series, and wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], with a HUD equipped in their helmet.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Fun to do. Sometimes it's better to be lucky than good.|Author Jason Fry, on writing CT-1226's section|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22128732052/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-5|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 5}}</ref>}}
CT-1226 first appeared in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]] as a guide dedicated to the conflicts in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Fry later commented in his [http://jasonfry.tumblr.com/post/20843004826/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-1 endnotes] to ''Warfare'' that writing the section that contained CT-1226 was fun to do, and that it was sometimes better to be lucky than good at something.<ref name="Endnotes" />
